title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Peach Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Looking for a deliciously satisfying vaping experience? Look no further than Peach Ice by Vice, the latest offering from VICE, the trusted brand known for its high-performance disposable vapes. Now branching out into salt nicotine e-liquids to meet the growing demand for premium flavors.
Featuring the sweet and succulent flavor of ripe peaches, expertly paired with a cooling burst of ice, Peach Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for anyone looking for a smooth and satisfying vape. Crafted with only the finest quality ingredients, this premium e-liquid delivers a rich and satisfying flavor that you won’t soon forget.
Whether you’re an experienced vaper or new to the game, Peach Ice by Vice is sure to please. So why wait? Order your bottles today from the vape wholesale experts and experience the deliciously refreshing flavor of Peach Ice by Vice.
Flavour Notes:
Peach
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
